user.title: DigiKabu student account
user.description: Enter your student login. Only documented student APIs are used. Your password is stored in Home Assistant; API tokens are kept in memory only.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate DigiKabu
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the password for the existing student account. An omitted API key keeps the previous key.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to DigiKabu. Try again later.
error.invalid_response: DigiKabu returned an unsupported response. See the documented response format limitations.
error.api_error: The student API request failed. Check that this account has access to the student absence overview.

invalid_excuse_date.message: An excuse must start today before 09:00 or tomorrow (Europe/Berlin). DigiKabu enforces the final restrictions.

authentication_failed.message: DigiKabu authentication failed. Reauthenticate this account in Settings.

get_absences.name: Get absences
get_absences.description: Read the student's absence overview. Returns the unmodified JSON under data.

get_timetable.name: Get own timetable
get_timetable.description: Read only the logged-in student's timetable. Returns the unmodified JSON under data.

datum.name: Start date and time
datum.description: Optional ISO datetime; omitted uses DigiKabu's default.

anzahl.name: Number of days
anzahl.description: Positive number of days from the start date.

get_card_timetable.name: Get card timetable
get_card_timetable.description: Prepare Monday-Friday rows for stundenplan-card and update the two on-demand card sensors. Uses Wiesau lesson times with the 10:00-10:15 break. Persists previous card reads to infer changes and cancellations, not official API statuses. Returns data.weeks.

datum.name: Date in first week
datum.description: Normalized to Monday in Europe/Berlin. Omitted means the current week.

weeks.name: Number of weeks
weeks.description: 1 or 2 consecutive weeks. A one-week request clears the second card sensor.

gruppe.name: Group (optional)
gruppe.description: Exact group, e.g. 1/2. Shared lessons (1/1 or no group) remain. Omit to display all parallel groups.

get_exams.name: Get exams
get_exams.description: Read the logged-in student's exams. Returns the unmodified JSON under data.

get_appointments.name: Get appointments
get_appointments.description: Read appointments for the student. No teacher department selector is used. Returns the unmodified JSON under data.

submit_excuse.name: Submit online excuse
submit_excuse.description: Sends a real excuse to DigiKabu. Never runs automatically. Verify the account, date and reason before invoking. On an unknown outcome, check DigiKabu before retrying.

ab_datum.name: Start date
ab_datum.description: Today before 09:00 or tomorrow, using Europe/Berlin school time. The time is normalized to midnight.

set_email.name: Set email addresses
set_email.description: Sends both email fields to DigiKabu. Both must be supplied explicitly. In YAML, null sends a nullable value; DigiKabu determines its meaning. No existing-address read endpoint is documented.
